svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram MeshCore repeater RX-TX flow
svg.text: ① RF: LoRa packet (preamble + header + payload)
⑧ SPI: readData() — fetch packet bytes
decision: ACTION_RETRANSMIT (priority from packet type or hop-count)
⑬ queueOutbound(pkt, prio, schedule = now + delay)

g.text: packet sits in queue; loop keeps running, other packets can slip in between
PHASE 5 — TX attempt with CAD + LBT

svg.text: ← packet with lowest prio (= fewest hops)
⑲ SPI: getRSSI() — only if int.thresh > 0
⑳ return: channel free or busy?

g.text: ㉑ wait 200ms, go back to ⑭
PHASE 6 — transmit (hardware does the work again)

svg.text: during this phase the chip is BUSY, no RX possible
㉚ SPI: startReceive() — back to continuous RX
… chip listens again for new preambles
